source.idea: Re-architect the Blueprint Details page as a client-first, API-optional live design workspace: one client state object + a browser-bundled engine drive every section; the LLM and the server are progressive enhancements, never required. Works fully offline / on GitHub Pages.

references.note: apps/web Details page + control plane (now optional)

goal_analysis.real_goal: Remove the hard API dependency so the workspace is instant and offline by default, and only gets richer (shared, AI-refined) when a backend/model is available.
goal_analysis.audience: Anyone running Matrix Builder — including on static hosting with no backend.
missing_decisions: client state library (Zustand vs React context)
where the browser engine lives (in-repo package vs inline module)

risks.risk: 3-hop API chain refuses connections / unavailable on static hosting.
risks.mitigation: Make the client engine the primary path; server + LLM are optional.

risks.risk: Live feel waits on network round-trips.
risks.mitigation: Apply chat mutations locally first, refine optionally afterward.

risks.risk: Two engines (Python brain + TS engine) drift.
risks.mitigation: Share the design-bundle schema + a conformance test across both.

framework_decision.rationale: Keep the existing Next.js/TS app; add a tiny client store + a pure-function engine bundled into the page. No new runtime, no required backend.

rejected.option: Keep the API-first 3-hop chain as the only path
rejected.why_not: Fragile, can't run on GitHub Pages, adds latency to a live workspace.
Re-introduces the backend dependency this plan removes.

visual_target.style: Unchanged — the premium dark live-workspace Details page already shipped.
must_avoid: any hard fetch on the render path
blocking spinners waiting on an API

systems: server-bridge — OPTIONAL control-plane sync behind a capability check
architecture.diagram: chat → store+engine (local, instant) → sections; optional → AI refine / server sync

data_model: BlueprintDetailsState { blueprint, overview, architecture, filePlan, batches[], designBrain, matrixRules[], chat, dirty }

functional: with the network fully blocked, the page generates, chat-edits, persists and reloads
chat mutations patch the affected sections instantly from the client engine
when a model is configured, an optional single AI call refines the local result; failure leaves the local result intact
when a backend is configured, state syncs; without it the UX is identical
web typecheck + build clean; engine unit tests green
performance: chat → visible section update with no network round-trip
accessibility: no blocking spinners; composer stays usable offline

batch_roadmap.name: Client state model
batch_roadmap.purpose: BlueprintDetailsState + blueprintStore as the single source of truth.
acceptance: sections render from the store with no fetch

batch_roadmap.name: Browser blueprint-engine
batch_roadmap.purpose: Deterministic in-browser engine: generate(idea) + apply(state, instruction).
new_features: apply: insert/rename/reorder/split batches; update architecture, file plan, design brain

batch_roadmap.name: Wire Details to store + engine
batch_roadmap.purpose: Chat calls apply() locally; sections patch instantly; remove the hard fetch from the render path.
new_features: no request needed to edit the plan
acceptance: airplane mode: 'add a boss level' adds a batch with no request

batch_roadmap.name: Optional AI enhancement
batch_roadmap.purpose: refineWithAI(state, instruction): one provider-agnostic call; on timeout/error return the local result.
acceptance: provider down → local result stands; UI never blocks

batch_roadmap.name: localStorage-first persistence
batch_roadmap.purpose: Autosave BlueprintDetailsState per build to localStorage; Unsaved/save reflect local state.
acceptance: reload restores the workspace with no server

batch_roadmap.name: Optional server bridge
batch_roadmap.purpose: Make /api/v1/blueprints/* an optional sync/enhancement target behind capabilities().
acceptance: with a server: syncs; without: identical UX

batch_roadmap.name: Proof: fully offline workspace
batch_roadmap.purpose: E2E with the network blocked: generate, chat-edit, persist, reload — all green.
acceptance: no request leaves the page; all interactions work offline
